responses.draft_cover_letter:
I am excited about the Application Security Engineer role at Vantage Health, where I can bring a collaborative security mindset to a team focused on protecting patient‑centric applications. In my current position I run the backend guild’s fortnightly design reviews, guiding engineers through security considerations and ensuring that architectural decisions align with best‑practice principles.

These design reviews have given me practical experience in evaluating threat surfaces and advocating for secure design choices early in the development cycle. Working closely with developers has sharpened my ability to communicate risks clearly and to influence secure coding practices across the codebase.

I recognize that my background does not yet include hands‑on penetration testing of web applications, formal OWASP Top 10 work, or integration of SAST/DAST tools in CI pipelines, nor do I hold an OSCP certification. I am eager to develop these capabilities, and I am committed to pursuing the necessary training and certifications to meet Vantage Health’s high standards. Likewise, I look forward to learning the specifics of healthcare compliance such as HIPAA and ISO 27001 to ensure our applications meet regulatory requirements.

I am confident that my proven experience leading security‑focused design reviews, combined with a strong willingness to grow in the required technical areas, will allow me to contribute effectively to Vantage Health’s application security program.
